mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM `user` WHERE user_name = #{username} AND user_id != #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM `user` WHERE phone = #{phone} AND user_id != #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `user` (user_name, password, role, phone) VALUES (#{username}, #{password}, #{role}, #{phone})
mapper.update: UPDATE `user` SET user_name = #{username}, password = #{password}, role = #{role}, phone = #{phone}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{userId}
